scenario: Station receive dwell: check flap closed behind the pipe plus the 50 ms flap-switch latency, after which the robot may leave
basis: Cycle-derived (cycle_rehearsal.py, plugin field rehearsal, Red 2 from its real slot with waitCycles yield): receive dwells of 0.50-1.00 s credit 15-14 L1 cycles and leave the two-delivery role unchanged, so a dwell up to 1.0 s costs it no score. The first draft held the robot until the pipe had seated (0.54 s model, 0.15-0.69 s with contact stiffness); the receive-and-go trials show it need not wait (24/24 retained and seated within 0.073 s of the stop)
